title: Common-refinement cancellation extends stage naturality
statement: Let Y be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] with its derived category [def-pc-derived-category], let D be any category, F : D(O_Y) → D and G : K(O_Y) → D be functors, and a_X : (Q_Y⋙F)(X) → G(X) for every flat telescope shift representative X [def-sc-flat-telescope-stage-map]. If a is natural for flatTelescopeStageMap morphisms, it is natural for every homotopy morphism between these representatives.

source.place: Common-refinement cancellation in step 3 of lem-sc-flat-telescope-bounded-normalization-extension; explicit refinement is an inherited agent expansion.

proof.text: For s:X→X′ obtain stage maps a:R→X and b:R→X′, with a a quasi-isomorphism and a;s=b. Q_Y and F send a to an isomorphism. Precompose the naturality equality with F(Q_Y(a)), rewrite using functoriality and a;s=b, use stage naturality for both b and a, and cancel.

mathlib_searches.query: Naturality follows after precomposition with invertible common refinements
mathlib_searches.verdict: No exact restricted-family statement; categorical cancellation proves it.
Used to cancel the invertible refinement.

mathlib_searches.query: Naturality follows from naturality on stage maps after cancellation of a common quasi-isomorphism refinement
